Anthony Edwards has never been shy about believing in himself. Since entering the NBA as the No. 1 pick in 2020, that confidence has become as recognizable as the explosiveness, scoring, and emotion he brings to the floor. But the confidence works because there’s something underneath it. Edwards plays like he expects the responsibility. Bigger moments don’t seem to make him smaller. If anything, they give him another reason to demand more from himself. There’s a difference between saying you belong and carrying yourself like you’ve already decided it.
